synthetic_eegdex_golden.node-export.json.note: EEGDex's first known answer. The input is a single-channel EEG EDF written by tools/make-synthetic-eeg-edf.mjs around EEGDSP.genSynthetic's own 1800 s signal: closed-form sines plus a seeded LCG, no RNG, no Date.now(), header identity fields 'X', no recording of any person. It is therefore committed by exact-name negation in .gitignore, so this leg runs in CI with no corpus. It is also the first fixture that puts ingestEDF in the gated path at all: the header clock, the int16 record decode, the physical scaling and the channel pick out of the header.

synthetic_eegdex_frames_golden.node-expo.note: EEGDex's second ingest, and the only committed input in the repo that carries TWO clocks. The input is a 60 s synthetic headband raw-frame capture written by tools/make-synthetic-raw-frames.mjs: a declared sum of sines plus a seeded LCG packed into genuine 14-bit frame bytes, a device tick that folds every 2^28 ns, and a host stamp column with up to 12 ms of delivery jitter and a planted rate offset of -49.9 ppm (the measured value for this device). No RNG, no Date.now(), no recording of any person, so it is committed by exact-name negation in .gitignore and this leg runs in CI with no corpus. WHAT IT PINS: the frame tokeniser, the 14-bit unpack, the tick unwrap, DexClock.hostAxis over the row anchors reporting independent true and deviceDrawn false (the realistic device axis clock.js asks a deviceDrawn adopter to re-cut its fixtures to), tMsBasis host-disciplined, the placed epoch time (epoch 1 lands 2 ms off its device-index time), and timingSource device+host. WHAT IT DOES NOT PIN: a rate, because 12 ms of jitter over 60 s swamps the 3.0 ms the plant moves; and nothing clinical, because the stage model declares needs_whole_night and two epochs make its night features degenerate by construction. The 1800 s EDF fixture beside it is the one that stages a plausible night.
